content: 1. Oral contraceptives have been demonstrated to significantly reduce plasma concentrations of lamotrigine, likely due to the induction of lamotrigine glucuronidation. 2. Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of norethindrone by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Lenacapavir may also increase CYP3A4 substrates initiated within nine months after the last subcutaneous dose, potentially raising the risk of adverse reactions associated with these substrates. 3. Letermovir increases norethindrone levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 4. Lopinavir increases the levels or effects of norethindrone by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 5. Norethindrone increases the levels of maraviroc by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary due to the potential for increased toxicity. 6. Norethindrone reduces the effects of metformin through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 7. Mifepristone decreases the effects of norethindrone via pharmacodynamic antagonism. Caution and monitoring are advised, and a backup contraceptive method is recommended. 8. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of norethindrone by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. Nonhormonal contraceptives are advised during therapy. 9. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of norethindrone by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 10. Nemolizumab decreases norethindrone levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Nemolizumab suppresses cytokines, potentially increasing CYP enzyme activity. Monitor for reduced systemic levels of narrow therapeutic index CYP substrates after initiating nemolizumab, and adjust dosages as needed. 11. Ritonavir increases the levels or effects of norethindrone by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 12. Rucaparib increases the levels or effects of norethindrone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Adjust the dosage of CYP3A4 substrates if clinically indicated. 13. Rufinamide decreases the effects of norethindrone by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rufinamide is a weak CYP3A4 inducer and can reduce the exposure of drugs that are CYP3A4 substrates. 14. Siltuximab may interact with norethindrone. Caution and monitoring are advised. Siltuximab inhibits IL-6, potentially restoring CYP450 enzymatic activity. Use caution when coadministering with CYP substrates that have a narrow therapeutic index. 15. Stiripentol affects norethindrone by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Stiripentol is both a CYP3A4 inhibitor and inducer. Monitor CYP3A4 substrates coadministered with stiripentol for increased or decreased effects, and adjust dosages as needed. 16. Tazemetostat decreases the levels or effects of norethindrone by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 17. Tecovirimat decreases the levels or effects of norethindrone by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Tecovirimat is a weak CYP3A4 inducer. Monitor sensitive CYP3A4 substrates for effectiveness if coadministered. 18. Tesamorelin decreases the levels or effects of norethindrone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Alternative contraception is advised. 19. Voriconazole increases the levels or effects of norethindrone by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 20. Acetazolamide increases the levels or effects of norethindrone by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 21. Anastrozole increases the levels or effects of norethindrone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 22. Cyclophosphamide increases the levels or effects of norethindrone by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 23. Danazol increases the levels or effects of norethindrone by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 24. Drospirenone increases the levels or effects of norethindrone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 25. Larotrectinib increases the levels or effects of norethindrone by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 26. Levoketoconazole increases the levels or effects of norethindrone by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 27. Ribociclib increases the levels or effects of norethindrone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 28. Acitretin decreases the effects of norethindrone through an unknown mechanism. This combination is contraindicated due to the risk of contraceptive failure. 29. Amobarbital decreases the levels or effects of norethindrone by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 30. Apalutamide decreases the levels or effects of norethindrone by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Apalutamide is a strong CYP3A4 inducer, and coadministration with CYP3A4 substrates can result in lower exposure to these medications. Evaluate for loss of therapeutic effect if coadministration is unavoidable. 31. Atazanavir may increase or decrease norethindrone levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Use alternatives if available. 32. Belzutifan decreases the levels or effects of norethindrone by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Belzutifan may lead to contraceptive failure or increased breakthrough bleeding. Advise females of reproductive potential to use effective nonhormonal contraception. 33. Bosentan decreases the levels or effects of norethindrone by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 34. Brigatinib decreases the levels or effects of norethindrone by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Brigatinib induces CYP3A4 and may reduce the efficacy of hormonal contraceptives. Women should use effective nonhormonal contraception during treatment and for at least four months after the last dose. 35. Carbamazepine decreases the levels or effects of norethindrone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Hormonal contraceptives are not reliable when coadministered with carbamazepine. 36. Cenobamate decreases the levels or effects of norethindrone by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Increase the dose of CYP3A4 substrates as needed. 37. Clobazam decreases the levels or effects of norethindrone by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Additional nonhormonal contraception is advised. 38. Colesevelam decreases norethindrone levels by drug binding in the gastrointestinal tract. Administer oral contraceptives containing norethindrone/ethinyl estradiol at least four hours before colesevelam to avoid decreased absorption. 39. Crofelemer increases norethindrone levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 40. Dabrafenib decreases the levels or effects of norethindrone by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. 41. Efavirenz decreases the levels or effects of norethindrone by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 42. Elagolix decreases norethindrone levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. 43. Encorafenib both inhibits and induces CYP3A4 at clinically relevant plasma concentrations. Coadministration with sensitive CYP3A4 substrates may result in increased toxicity or decreased efficacy. 44. Enzalutamide decreases the levels or effects of norethindrone by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Hormonal contraceptives are not reliable when coadministered with enzalutamide. 45. Etravirine decreases the levels or effects of norethindrone by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 46. Fedratinib increases norethindrone levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Adjust the dose of CYP3A4 substrates as necessary. 47. Fexinidazole increases norethindrone levels by inhibiting CYP3A4. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 48. Fosphenytoin decreases the levels or effects of norethindrone by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 49. Idelalisib increases norethindrone levels by inhibiting CYP3A4. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 50. Iloperidone increases norethindrone levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 51. Indinavir increases norethindrone levels by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 52. Norethindrone decreases the effects of insulin degludec by pharmacodynamic antagonism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 53. Istradefylline increases norethindrone levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 54. Ivosidenib decreases norethindrone levels by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug.
